messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to ondansetron.
These signs include a rash and hives.
These signs also include fever and chills.
These signs also include difficult breathing.
These signs also include swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
severe constipation, stomach pain, or bloating;
sudden chest pain or chest tightness, severe dizziness, fainting, fast or pounding heartbeats;
fast or pounding heartbeats;
jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes);
blurred vision or temporary vision loss (lasting from only a few minutes to several hours);
high levels of serotonin in the body--agitation, hallucinations, fever, fast heart rate, overactive reflexes, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of coordination, fainting.
Common ondansetron side effects may include:
diarrhea or constipation;
headache;
drowsiness; or
tired feeling.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
